answer.original_source: NN, Inc.; the announcement was reported by Yahoo Finance. The exact announcement day is not stated; the reported event was in late June 2026.
answer.new_information: NN announced 47 additional machine centers at its Wuxi plant for liquid-cooling production for NVIDIA AI data center racks. The article also reports NN's claim that all of this new capacity was pre-sold under multi-year, multi-product awards and a target of US$80–US$90 million of accretive new business in 2026. These are NN-specific supplier-capacity and business-target claims, not evidence of NVIDIA's own sales, orders, or financial results. No linked questions or stored pieces were supplied, so there is nothing to update or compare.
